name: search_design_knowledge
description: Search Motif's design guidance library (739 guides on web, app, SaaS, PWA and motion design: layout, type, colour, motion, accessibility, performance, conversion). Returns up to 5 matches with title, abstract and whether this account can open them; never the full text. Use short topical queries (e.g. 'pricing page plan toggle', 'mobile bottom sheet', 'hero video performance'), then open a result with get_design_guidance. Counts one content operation.
